title: Fronius Solar Web Failure Rate
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fronius:solar
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(inverter_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by inverter_id
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Fronius inverter reading records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each inverter.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize inverter_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per inverter.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It catches which parts of your Fronius inverter reading data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
